I'm like aiming for the stars 🤩 but ending up in black holes 🕳️ all the time lol

Folks, if you know about *building* #Kubernetes (not just deploying prebuilt components or distros like Rancher, Talos, k3s etc), please reach out - I have a pipe dream that you could be part of:

A pile of cute little pile of boxes booting from 0 to k8s in less than 10 seonds.
(I ought to visualize it)

Think about it. It will be excellent for personal use.
No hacks, no gimmicks; a fully trustwortjy local platform.
